strings: How to Create Realistic Mockups with Your Brand Kit using Lovart AI
Instantly apply your brand identity to real-world products. Use Lovart's AI Design Agent to generate photorealistic mockups for packaging, apparel, and digital devices directly from your Brand Kit.
Get started
Why Lovart Mockups Are Better Than PSD Templates
Texture-Aware Blending
The AI understands materials. Your logo will bend with the fabric of a shirt or show the grain of a cardboard box, creating hyper-realistic results.
Infinite Scenarios
You are not limited by available stock photos. Create any background environment you can imagine to perfectly match your campaign's mood.
One-Click Brand Application
Apply your stored Brand Kit to dozens of different items in seconds. Visualize a full merchandise line without manual editing.
Lighting Control
Want dramatic shadows or soft studio light? The Agent lets you control the lighting environment to highlight your product's best features.
Multiple Angles
Generate front, side, and top-down views of your product on the same canvas to create a comprehensive product showcase.
Transparent Backgrounds
Need the object isolated? Easily remove the background from your generated mockup to use the product image on your website or catalog.
Bring Your Brand to Life with AI-Generated Mockups

Skip the photoshoot and Photoshop. Lovart's AI Design Agent intelligently applies your Brand Kit—logos, colors, and patterns—onto photorealistic 3D objects. From packaging to apparel, generate stunning product visuals in any setting instantly.

Generate Mockup
Create Professional Mockups in 3 Simple Steps
Load Your Brand Kit
Don't upload assets every time. Lovart stores your logos, color palettes, and fonts in your Brand Kit. Simply select the brand you're working on, and the Agent knows exactly what assets to use.
Describe the Scene
Forget searching for the perfect template. Just type what you need. "A billboard in Times Square" or "A business card on a mossy rock." The AI generates the unique scene from scratch.
Smart Wrap & Render
Lovart automatically wraps your logo onto the 3D surface, adjusting for curves, shadows, and textures. Use 'Edit Elements' to fine-tune the size and position for the perfect shot.

Marketing Director
Can I use my own logo files?
Yes, you can upload your own PNG, SVG, or JPG logo files to your Brand Kit or directly onto the canvas. Lovart's AI will then integrate them into the generated mockup.
How realistic are the mockups?

Lovart uses advanced rendering models (like Nano Banana) that understand physics, lighting, and material properties. The result is a photorealistic image that looks like it was taken in a professional studio.
Does it work for apparel?
Absolutely. Apparel is one of our strongest use cases. The AI accurately wraps designs around the human form, accounting for folds, posture, and lighting conditions.
Can I edit the placement of the logo after generating?
Yes. With the 'Edit Elements' feature, you can select your logo layer and move, resize, or rotate it on the object until it sits perfectly.
Do I need a 3D model of my product?
No. You don't need any 3D files. Just describe your product (e.g., 'a square cardboard box') and the AI generates the 3D representation for you.
